user.title: Connect to a Blackmagic ATEM switcher
user.description: Enter the IP address of your ATEM switcher. Home Assistant will connect over the network to confirm it is reachable.

data_description.host: The IP address or hostname of the ATEM switcher.
data_description.name: Optional name for this switcher. Defaults to the model reported by the switcher.

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect. Check the IP address and that the switcher is powered on and reachable on the network.

abort.already_configured: This ATEM switcher is already configured.
